content.title: Freeport-McMoRan and Miner Stocks Climb as Copper Tests Fresh Record
content.summary: Copper hit a record high of just under 100,000 yuan (about $14,270) a ton in overnight futures trading Friday in Shanghai.  It was last marked at $5.857 a pound on the Commodity Exchange, or Comex—a 5% advance on the session that takes copper’s 2025 gain to around 45%.  Copper futures on Comex have surged nearly 82% since early July, when President Donald Trump floated the idea of a 50% tariff on U.S. copper imports—following a so-called Section 232 investigation into alleged national security concerns tied to the metal.
